infobox.usage: Unlocks a door on the fourth floor of the Klimova 16A building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Rusted bloody key (Rusted) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A rusted bloody key, inscribed on it is: "He who holds this key shall wander for eternity".

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
- Cannot be put inside secure containers

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest The Door

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text: Inside the Klimov shopping mall, on the first floor on a pegboard underneath the escalators. It can appear at both spawn locations in the same raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door on the fourth floor of the Klimova 16A building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Keys
- Valuables
- Medical supplies
- Info items
- Tools
- Flammable materials
- Medical items
- Stimulants
- Drinks

- M9A3 spawn
- M870 spawn
- Mosin 7.62x54R bolt-action rifle (Sniper) spawn

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text: | Pointy guy figurine x1; Pointy guy figurine | → | Cultist Circle; Unique Sacrifice; 1 h 6 min | → | Rusted bloody key x1; Rusted bloody key |

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - Easter eggs and References: This key is a direct reference to a key of the same name featured in the game Silent Hill 4: The Room.
